PRIVACY_POLICY:
This Privacy Policy explains how {{STORE_NAME}} collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information when you visit {{WEBSITE_URL}}, place an order, or otherwise interact with us. Please read it carefully so you understand our practices.

Last updated: {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}}

1. Who We Are (Data Controller)

The business responsible for your personal information (the data controller) is:

  • Legal name: {{LEGAL_NAME}} (trading as {{STORE_NAME}})
  • Country of operation: {{COUNTRY}}
  • Privacy contact email: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
  • Customer support email: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}

If you have any questions about this policy or how we handle your data, you can reach us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

2. Information We Collect

We collect the following categories of personal information:

  • Contact details: your name, email address, phone number, and billing address.
  • Order and delivery details: the products you buy, your shipping address, order history, delivery preferences, and any notes you add to an order.
  • Payment data: the payment method you use and the transaction amount. Full card numbers and banking credentials are entered on and handled by our third party payment processors. We do not store complete card details on our own systems.
  • Account information: if you create an account, your login credentials and saved preferences.
  • Communications: the content of messages, emails, chat, and support requests you send to us, including reviews and survey responses.
  • Device and usage data: your IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, referring pages, the pages you view on {{WEBSITE_URL}}, and how you interact with our site.
  • Cookies and similar technologies: identifiers and analytics data collected through cookies, pixels, and tags, as described in our Cookie Policy.

We do not intentionally collect special categories of sensitive personal information (such as data about your health, race, religion, or political views), and we ask that you do not send such information to us unless it is strictly necessary.

3. How We Collect Your Information

We obtain personal information in three main ways:

  • Directly from you: when you place an order, create an account, subscribe to marketing, contact support, leave a review, or fill in a form.
  • Automatically: when you browse {{WEBSITE_URL}}, our servers and cookies record device and usage data.
  • From third parties: payment processors, shipping carriers, fraud prevention services, and analytics or advertising partners may share limited information with us to complete and secure your order.

4. Purposes of Processing and Legal Bases

We process your personal information only where we have a valid legal basis to do so. The list below summarizes why we use your data and the lawful ground we rely on. Where the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or the UK GDPR applies, these lawful bases are contract, consent, legitimate interests, and legal obligation, as set out here.

  • To process and fulfil your orders, including payment, shipping, and delivery updates. Legal basis: performance of a contract with you.
  • To provide customer support and respond to your questions, returns, and refund requests. Legal basis: performance of a contract and our legitimate interests in serving customers.
  • To manage your account and keep your order history. Legal basis: performance of a contract.
  • To prevent fraud and secure our store and payments. Legal basis: legitimate interests and compliance with legal obligations.
  • To send marketing communications such as newsletters and promotions. Legal basis: your consent, or our legitimate interests where permitted by law. You can withdraw consent or unsubscribe at any time.
  • To analyse and improve our website, products, and services. Legal basis: legitimate interests and, for non essential cookies, your consent.
  • To comply with legal, tax, and accounting obligations. Legal basis: compliance with a legal obligation.

Where we rely on legitimate interests, we balance those interests against your rights and freedoms, and you can object to this processing as described in the rights sections below.

5. Order Fulfilment and Third Parties We Share Data With

We operate a worldwide store and, for some products, a dropshipping model. This means that when you place an order, your order and delivery details may be shared with suppliers and carriers so the goods can be shipped to you, sometimes directly from the supplier. We share personal information only as needed to run our business and complete your order, and we require these partners to protect your data. The categories of recipients include:

  • Payment processors: to authorise and settle payments securely and to detect fraud.
  • Shipping and logistics carriers: to deliver your order and provide tracking. This may involve customs authorities where required for cross border shipments.
  • Suppliers and fulfilment partners: including dropshipping suppliers who receive the name, shipping address, and order details needed to pack and dispatch your items.
  • Technology and hosting providers: our ecommerce platform, hosting, and IT service providers that keep the store running.
  • Analytics providers: to understand site performance and usage.
  • Marketing and advertising providers: to deliver, measure, and improve our communications and campaigns.
  • Professional advisers and authorities: such as accountants, legal advisers, and regulators, where required by law or to protect our rights.

We do not sell your personal information for money. If our business is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction, and we will notify you of any material change.

6. International Data Transfers

Because we sell and ship worldwide and work with suppliers and service providers in different countries, your personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your own, including {{COUNTRY}} and the countries where our suppliers and carriers are located. These countries may have data protection laws that differ from those where you live. When we transfer personal data internationally, we take steps to ensure it remains protected, for example by relying on adequacy decisions, the European Commission and UK standard contractual clauses, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement, or other lawful transfer mechanisms where they apply. You can contact us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} for more information about these safeguards or to request a copy where one is available.

7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to operate {{WEBSITE_URL}}, remember your preferences, analyse traffic, and support marketing. Some cookies are essential for the site to function, while others are optional and used only with your consent where required. You can manage your preferences through our cookie settings and your browser controls. For full details about the cookies we use and how to control them, please see our Cookie Policy.

8. Data Retention

We keep your personal information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy. In practice:

  • Order and transaction records are kept for as long as needed to fulfil the order and then for the period required by tax, accounting, and legal obligations.
  • Account information is kept while your account remains active and for a reasonable period afterwards.
  • Marketing data is kept until you unsubscribe or withdraw consent, and for a short period afterwards to honour your request.
  • Support communications are kept for as long as needed to resolve your matter and maintain our records.

When your information is no longer needed, we securely delete it or anonymise it so it can no longer identify you.

9. How We Protect Your Information

We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information against loss, misuse, unauthorised access, and disclosure. These measures include encryption of data in transit, restricted access to personal data, secure payment processing through trusted providers, and regular review of our security practices. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we work to protect your data and to respond promptly to any incident.

10. Children's Privacy

Our store is intended for adults and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below the age required by the laws of their country. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} so we can delete it.

11. Your Privacy Rights (General)

Depending on where you live, you may have some or all of the following rights over your personal information:

  • Access: to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Correction: to ask us to fix inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Deletion: to request that we erase your personal data in certain circumstances.
  • Restriction and objection: to limit or object to certain processing, including direct marketing.
  • Portability: to receive your data in a portable format or have it transferred where technically feasible.
  • Withdraw consent: to withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
  • Complain: to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

To exercise any of these rights, email us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} with details of your request. We may need to verify your identity before acting, and we will respond within the time frame required by applicable law. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time using the link in each message.

12. Your Rights in the EU, EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Union, the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, the GDPR and the UK GDPR give you the following rights over your personal information:

  • Right of access: to obtain confirmation that we process your data and receive a copy of it.
  • Right to rectification: to have inaccurate or incomplete personal data corrected.
  • Right to erasure: to have your personal data deleted in certain circumstances (the right to be forgotten).
  • Right to restriction of processing: to limit how we use your data in certain circumstances.
  • Right to data portability: to receive the data you provided in a structured, commonly used, machine readable format and to have it transmitted to another controller where technically feasible.
  • Right to object: to object to processing based on legitimate interests and to object at any time to the use of your data for direct marketing.
  • Right to withdraw consent: to withdraw consent at any time where our processing is based on consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
  • Rights regarding automated decisions: not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal or similarly significant effects. We do not use such automated decision making in a way that affects you.
  • Right to lodge a complaint: to complain to your local data protection supervisory authority. In the United Kingdom this is the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO). We would appreciate the chance to address your concerns first, so please consider contacting us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

We will respond to valid requests within one month, which may be extended for complex requests as permitted by law. Exercising these rights is free of charge in most cases.

13. Your Rights if You Are a California Resident (CCPA and CPRA)

If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act, gives you the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • Right to know: to request the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you, the sources of that information, the purposes for collecting it, and the categories of third parties with whom we share it.
  • Right to delete: to request that we delete the personal information we have collected from you, subject to certain legal exceptions.
  • Right to correct: to request that we correct inaccurate personal information we hold about you.
  • Right to opt out of sale or sharing: to opt out of the sale of your personal information and of sharing it for cross context behavioural advertising. We do not sell your personal information for money. To the extent that certain advertising activities are treated as a sale or sharing under California law, you can opt out by contacting us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} or through the cookie settings on our site.
  • Right to limit use of sensitive personal information: to limit the use and disclosure of any sensitive personal information to what is necessary to provide our services.
  • Right to non-discrimination: not to receive discriminatory treatment for exercising any of your privacy rights, including no denial of service, different prices, or lower quality.

To exercise these rights, contact us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}. You may use an authorised agent to submit a request on your behalf, and we may ask you to verify your identity or the agent's authority before we act. We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights.

14. Third Party Links

Our website may contain links to other websites and services that we do not control. This Privacy Policy does not apply to those third party sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any external site you visit.

15. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. When we make changes, we will revise the "Last updated" date shown near the top of this page, and where the changes are significant we will take reasonable steps to notify you. The version in force is the one published at {{WEBSITE_URL}} with an effective date of {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}}. Your continued use of our store after an update means you accept the revised policy.

16. Contact Us

If you have questions, concerns, or requests about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact:

  • {{LEGAL_NAME}} (trading as {{STORE_NAME}})
  • Privacy email: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
  • Support email: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}

This policy is governed by the laws of your own country of residence.
REFUND_POLICY:
Last updated: {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}}

This Refund and Return Policy explains how returns, exchanges, and refunds work at {{STORE_NAME}}, operated by {{LEGAL_NAME}} ({{WEBSITE_URL}}), based in {{COUNTRY}}. Because we sell and ship worldwide and some of our products are fulfilled directly by our suppliers, please read this policy carefully before placing an order. By purchasing from {{STORE_NAME}}, you agree to the terms described below.

Your Consumer Rights

Nothing in this policy limits or removes any rights you may have under the mandatory consumer protection laws that apply to you. Where local law grants you stronger rights than those described here, those legal rights always take precedence. In particular, if an item is defective, damaged, or not as described, you are entitled to a remedy at no cost to you, as set out in the section below on damaged, defective, or incorrect items.

Right of Withdrawal for Consumers in the European Union

If you are a consumer resident in the European Union, you have the right to withdraw from your purchase within 14 days without giving any reason, in addition to any other rights described in this policy. This statutory right of withdrawal applies to distance contracts under the EU Consumer Rights Directive.

Withdrawal period. The withdrawal period is 14 days from the day on which you, or a third party other than the carrier indicated by you, acquire physical possession of the goods. Where your order consists of multiple goods ordered together but delivered separately, the period runs from the day on which you acquire physical possession of the last item.

How to exercise it. To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us, {{LEGAL_NAME}} (trading as {{STORE_NAME}}), at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}, of your decision by a clear statement (for example, a letter sent by post or an email). You may use the model withdrawal form set out below, but it is not obligatory. To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning the exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.

Effects of withdrawal. If you withdraw, we will reimburse all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (except for the supplementary costs arising if you chose a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event no later than 14 days from the day on which we are informed of your decision to withdraw. We will make the reimbursement using the same means of payment you used for the initial transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of the reimbursement. We may withhold the reimbursement until we have received the goods back, or until you have supplied evidence of having sent back the goods, whichever is the earliest.

Who pays for the return. You must send back the goods or hand them over to us without undue delay and in any event no later than 14 days from the day on which you communicate your withdrawal. The deadline is met if you send back the goods before the period of 14 days has expired. You will have to bear the direct cost of returning the goods. You are only liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling other than what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics, and functioning.

Exceptions. The right of withdrawal does not apply to certain contracts, including the supply of goods made to your specifications or clearly personalised, goods liable to deteriorate or expire rapidly, and sealed goods which are not suitable for return for health protection or hygiene reasons and were unsealed after delivery, as permitted by the EU Consumer Rights Directive.

Model Withdrawal Form

(Complete and return this form only if you wish to withdraw from the contract.)

  • To {{LEGAL_NAME}} (trading as {{STORE_NAME}}), {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}:
  • I/We hereby give notice that I/We withdraw from my/our contract of sale of the following goods:
  • Ordered on / received on:
  • Name of consumer(s):
  • Address of consumer(s):
  • Signature of consumer(s) (only if this form is notified on paper):
  • Date:

Return Eligibility and Return Window

You may request a return within {{RETURN_WINDOW}} of the date your order was delivered. To be eligible, your request must be submitted within this window by contacting us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}. Requests made after the return window has closed may not be accepted, except where a longer period is required by the law that applies to you.

Condition of Items for Return

To qualify for a return, items must meet all of the following conditions:

  • Unused and unworn, in the same condition in which you received them.
  • In the original packaging, undamaged and complete.
  • With all tags, labels, and protective seals attached.
  • Accompanied by proof of purchase, such as your order number or receipt.

Items returned in a used, damaged, incomplete, or altered condition (where the item itself was not faulty) may be refused or may qualify only for a partial refund.

Non-Returnable and Final-Sale Items

Certain products cannot be returned or refunded for health, safety, or practical reasons, unless they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. These include:

  • Perishable goods (for example food, flowers, or other items with a limited shelf life).
  • Personal care and hygiene products (for example cosmetics, skincare, grooming, or intimate items) once opened or unsealed.
  • Custom, made-to-order, or personalized items.
  • Digital products and downloadable content.
  • Gift cards.
  • Items clearly marked as final sale or clearance at the time of purchase.

Order Cancellation

If you change your mind after placing an order, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} as soon as possible. Orders are usually prepared for dispatch within {{PROCESSING_TIME}}, so we can often cancel or amend an order that has not yet been processed. Once an order has been dispatched, it can no longer be cancelled, and you will need to follow the standard return process described in this policy. As a general guide, delivery takes around {{DOMESTIC_SHIPPING_TIME}} for domestic orders and {{INTERNATIONAL_SHIPPING_TIME}} for international orders, and your return window begins on the date your order is delivered.

How to Start a Return

To begin a return, contact our support team at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with the following information:

  • Your order number.
  • The name of the item or items you wish to return.
  • The reason for the return.
  • Clear photos of the product, if it is damaged, defective, or incorrect.

Once we receive your request, we will review it and reply with the next steps, including the correct return address and any instructions. Please do not send items back before receiving confirmation from us, as returns sent without prior approval may not be processed. Because some orders are shipped from different fulfilment locations, the return address we provide may differ from the address printed on your original package.

Who Pays for Return Shipping

Customers are responsible for return shipping costs, except where the item received was defective, damaged, or incorrect. In those cases, {{STORE_NAME}} will cover the reasonable cost of return shipping or provide a prepaid label, so that you are never out of pocket for our error.

We recommend using a trackable shipping service and, where appropriate, purchasing shipping insurance. We cannot guarantee that we will receive your returned item, and original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Restocking Policy

Most returns are processed without a restocking fee. However, we reserve the right to apply a reasonable restocking fee, or to issue a partial refund, for items that are returned incomplete, without original packaging, or with signs of use. No restocking fee will ever apply to items that are defective, damaged, or incorrect. Where a restocking fee applies, we will inform you before completing your refund.

Exchanges

If you would like a different size, color, or variant, the fastest option is usually to return the eligible item for a refund and place a new order for the item you want. If you prefer a direct exchange, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will let you know whether an exchange is available for your product. For exchanges that are not the result of a defective, damaged, or incorrect item, return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer.

Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items

We want you to receive your order in perfect condition. If your item arrives damaged, defective, or you received the wrong product, please contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} within {{RETURN_WINDOW}} of delivery and include:

  • Your order number.
  • A description of the problem.
  • Clear photos or video showing the damage, defect, or incorrect item, along with the packaging where relevant.

Once we confirm the issue, we will make it right at no additional cost to you. You may choose a free replacement, a reshipment of the correct item, or a full refund. In these cases, we will also cover any return shipping that is required, either by providing a prepaid label or by reimbursing your reasonable return postage. You will never be asked to pay to resolve a problem that was our fault.

Refund Method

Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method. We are unable to refund to a different card, account, or payment method than the one used for the original purchase. Refunds are processed in your local currency, and any difference in the final amount you receive due to currency conversion or bank fees is outside our control.

Refund Processing Time

Once we receive and inspect your returned item, or once we approve a refund for a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, we will notify you of the outcome. If approved, your refund will be processed within {{REFUND_TIME}}. Please note that after we issue the refund, it may take additional time for your bank or payment provider to post the funds to your account.

Partial Refunds

In some situations, only a partial refund may be granted. This may apply to:

  • Items returned outside the stated conditions (used, missing parts, or without original packaging).
  • Items with damage not caused by our error.
  • Returns where a restocking fee applies.

Where a partial refund applies, we will explain the reason and the amount before finalizing it.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you have not received a refund that we have confirmed as issued, please take the following steps:

  • Check your bank account or payment method again.
  • Contact your credit card company or payment provider, as there is often a processing delay before a refund is officially posted.
  • Contact your bank, as some institutions require additional time to complete the transfer.

If you have done all of this and still have not received your refund, please contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will help you resolve it.

Gifts

If an item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, any approved refund is issued to the person who originally placed and paid for the order, using their original payment method. If you received a gift and it is faulty or incorrect, please contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will help arrange a suitable remedy.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Refund and Return Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or in applicable law. The version in force at the time of your purchase governs that order. Any updates take effect once posted on {{WEBSITE_URL}}, and the date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

Governing Law

Because we sell and ship worldwide, this policy always respects the mandatory consumer protection rights you have in your own country of residence. Where local consumer law provides you with greater protection, that law continues to apply to you.

Privacy

Any personal information you share with us when requesting a return, exchange, or refund is handled in line with our Privacy Policy and used only to process and support your request. For questions about how we handle your data, contact us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

Company Information

This store is operated by the following business:

  • Legal name: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
  • Trading as: {{STORE_NAME}}
  • Country of operation: {{COUNTRY}}

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Refund and Return Policy, or you need help with a return, exchange, or refund, please reach out to us:

  • Store: {{STORE_NAME}} ({{LEGAL_NAME}})
  • Support email: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}
  • Website: {{WEBSITE_URL}}

We aim to respond to all return and refund enquiries as quickly as possible and to make the process simple and fair.
SHIPPING_POLICY:
Last updated: {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}}

This Shipping Policy explains how {{STORE_NAME}} processes, ships, and delivers orders placed on {{WEBSITE_URL}}. {{STORE_NAME}} works with trusted suppliers and fulfilment partners around the world, which means some items are shipped directly from our partners to you. By placing an order, you agree to the terms described below. If you have any questions before or after buying, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.

Definitions and Business Days

In this policy, "business days" means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays in {{COUNTRY}} and, where relevant, in the country a shipment is dispatched from. "Processing time" is the period we need to prepare your order before it is handed to a carrier. "Delivery time" is the period the carrier needs to transport your order after dispatch. "Dispatch" means the point at which your order leaves our facility or that of a fulfilment partner. All time estimates refer to business days unless stated otherwise.

Order Processing Time

All orders are reviewed and prepared before they are handed to a carrier. Our standard processing time is {{PROCESSING_TIME}}. Processing covers order verification, quality checks, and packaging. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays begin processing on the next business day. During promotions, product launches, and peak seasons, processing may take slightly longer, and we appreciate your patience.

Delivery Estimates

Once your order has been processed and dispatched, estimated delivery times are as follows:

  • Domestic delivery: {{DOMESTIC_SHIPPING_TIME}} after dispatch.
  • International delivery: {{INTERNATIONAL_SHIPPING_TIME}} after dispatch.

The total time to receive your order is the processing time plus the delivery time shown above.

Please note that all delivery times are estimates only and are not guaranteed. They are based on typical carrier performance and do not account for factors outside our control, such as customs clearance, carrier delays, weather, or high-volume periods. An estimate is our best expectation, not a firm commitment or a delivery guarantee.

Shipping Destinations

{{STORE_NAME}} ships worldwide to most countries and regions. Some destinations may be unavailable due to carrier limitations, local regulations, or restrictions on certain products. If we are unable to ship to your location, we will contact you using the email or phone number provided at checkout and, where appropriate, arrange a refund. Delivery addresses that are remote or difficult for carriers to reach may require additional transit time.

Shipping Rates and Free Shipping

Shipping rates are calculated and displayed at checkout before you complete your purchase, so you can review the full cost before paying. Rates may vary based on destination, order weight, dimensions, and the shipping method selected. All charges are shown in your local currency.

  • Standard shipping costs are added at checkout and shown clearly before payment.
  • We may offer free shipping on orders that meet or exceed a qualifying order value. When a free shipping threshold applies, it is displayed at checkout and on relevant pages of {{WEBSITE_URL}}.
  • Any free shipping promotion applies to the order subtotal only and may exclude taxes, duties, and certain products or destinations.

Order Confirmation, Changes and Cancellations

After you place an order, we will send an order confirmation to the email address provided at checkout. If you need to change or cancel an order, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} as soon as possible, ideally within the processing window. We will do our best to accommodate reasonable requests before dispatch. Once an order has been dispatched, it can no longer be changed or cancelled, and any return would follow our Refund and Return Policy.

Order Tracking

Once your order is dispatched, we will send a shipping confirmation email to the address you provided at checkout. This email includes your tracking number and a link to follow your shipment, as soon as the carrier makes tracking available. Please allow a short period after dispatch for the tracking information to update, as carriers may take one or more business days to register the first scan. If you have not received tracking details within a reasonable time, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will help.

Because some orders are fulfilled by different partners, a tracking number may become active a little after your dispatch confirmation is sent.

Multiple Shipments for Multi-Item Orders

If your order contains more than one item, your products may be shipped from different locations or fulfilment partners. As a result, items in the same order can arrive separately and at different times, and you may receive more than one tracking number. This is normal and does not mean part of your order is missing. If any item has not arrived within a reasonable window after the others, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will investigate.

Customs, Duties, Import Taxes and VAT

For international orders, your shipment may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, VAT, or other fees charged by the destination country. These charges are the sole responsibility of the customer and are not included in the product price or shipping cost at checkout. Customs policies vary widely from country to country, so we recommend checking with your local customs office before ordering if you are unsure about potential charges. {{STORE_NAME}} has no control over these fees and cannot predict or reimburse them. Refusal to pay applicable duties or taxes may result in your package being returned or held, and any related costs may be deducted from a refund.

Possible Delays

While we and our carriers work to deliver on time, delays can occur for reasons beyond our control, including:

  • Customs inspections and clearance procedures for international shipments.
  • Carrier disruptions, operational backlogs, or logistical issues.
  • Peak seasons and holidays, such as major sales events and end-of-year periods.
  • Severe weather, natural events, or other force majeure circumstances.
  • Incomplete or incorrect delivery information.

We will do our best to keep you informed if we become aware of a significant delay affecting your order.

Incorrect or Incomplete Addresses

Please review your shipping address carefully before completing your order. {{STORE_NAME}} is not responsible for orders shipped to an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the customer. If you notice a mistake, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} as quickly as possible, ideally within the processing window, and we will try to correct it before dispatch. Once an order has shipped, we may not be able to change the destination. Packages returned to us due to an incorrect address, a failed delivery, or an unclaimed shipment may be reshipped at an additional cost, or refunded minus any shipping and handling fees incurred.

Failed Delivery and Risk of Loss

Carriers may make one or more delivery attempts, and some destinations may require a signature or collection from a local pickup point. If a package cannot be delivered and is returned to sender, we will contact you to arrange a reshipment or a refund in line with this policy and our Refund and Return Policy. Responsibility for the goods passes to you once the order is delivered to the address you provided, or once it is made available for collection where a pickup or signature is required.

Lost, Stuck or Delayed Packages

If your tracking has not updated for an extended period, appears stuck, or your package has not arrived within the estimated timeframe, please reach out to us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}. Our support team will:

  • Review your tracking history and current shipment status.
  • Open an inquiry or trace request with the carrier where appropriate.
  • Keep you updated as we work toward a resolution.
  • Where a package is confirmed lost in transit, arrange a suitable remedy such as a replacement or a refund, in line with our policies.

Please allow us reasonable time to investigate with the carrier before a package is officially declared lost, as many delayed shipments are eventually delivered.

Damaged Items on Arrival

We want every order to arrive in perfect condition. If your item arrives damaged or defective, contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} within a reasonable time of delivery, and include:

  • Your order number.
  • Clear photos or a video showing the damage.
  • A short description of the issue and, if relevant, the packaging condition.

Once we have reviewed the details, we will arrange an appropriate solution, which may include a replacement or a refund. Keeping the original packaging can help us resolve carrier claims more quickly.

Returns and Refunds

Shipping is only one part of your experience with us. For details on returning items, our return window of {{RETURN_WINDOW}}, and refund processing times of {{REFUND_TIME}}, please see our Refund and Return Policy. Original shipping charges may be non-refundable except where required by law or where an item arrived damaged or incorrect.

Data Protection
